objective: Define how validated JNU modules may eventually be combined without fixed indicator voting or post-hoc weight fitting.

evidence.reference: Wang & Nishiyama (2015), Volatility forecast of stock indices by model averaging using high-frequency data
evidence.implication: Model averaging can improve one-day volatility forecasts; evaluation used SPA-style predictive comparison.

evidence.reference: Liu & Maheu (2009), Forecasting realized volatility: a Bayesian model-averaging approach
evidence.implication: Averaging over volatility specifications can improve forecast density and modestly improve point forecasts under model uncertainty.

evidence.reference: Amendola et al. (2020), Model Confidence Set approach to volatility forecast combination
evidence.implication: Select an accuracy-surviving model set before combining rather than averaging an unrestricted model universe.

hard_rules: Never combine a rejected or data-inconclusive family as if it were validated evidence.
Never assign fixed weights such as NQ 30%, USDJPY 20%, News 20% without a separate preregistered OOS combination test.
Agreement count is not confidence; correlated inputs cannot be treated as independent votes.
A risk-state module may change size/stops/no-trade confidence but cannot create directional probability by itself.
An event/news volatility-state pass cannot be converted into long/short direction without a separate directional family.
A source-weighting DPD layer may determine which observed market is trusted but is not a directional vote.
Every combined model is itself a new candidate family and must pass the promotion pipeline.

directional_pool.admission: Only true-JNU-confirmed directional modules that passed applicable overfit gates.

execution_pool.admission: Execution variables such as VWAP/POC/liquidity/basis after causal definitions are fixed.
execution_pool.role: Entry/exit/invalidation/cost quality, not independent alpha by default.

future_combination_protocol.prerequisite: Each candidate must already have standalone OOS predictions from the same evaluation timestamps without reusing target outcomes.
initial_benchmarks: Equal weight among eligible validated forecasts
Best single validated forecast chosen only from training window
preferred_methods_for_review: Model Confidence Set then equal-weight survivors
Dynamic model averaging only if forgetting/weight-update parameters are preregistered
evaluation: Out-of-sample proper scoring rule appropriate to target
Incremental loss versus best single validated module
SPA/Reality-Check-style protection when many combinations are examined
Existing CPCV/PBO/DSR/Holm Stage-3 gate for executable strategy translations
forbidden: Optimize combination weights on final OOS
Choose the combination method after seeing test results
Add failed predictors because ensemble performance looks better

probability_outputs.rule: P(up)/P(down)/P(range) may be emitted as model probabilities only after calibration is measured on untouched OOS/forward data.
probability_outputs.when_no_directional_module: Report NO_VALIDATED_DIRECTIONAL_EDGE rather than manufacture a directional probability.
probability_outputs.confidence: Derived from calibration, predictive loss, data quality and regime validity—not number of indicators agreeing.
